factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 11) shows total assets of EUR 25,916,954 as of 30.06.2025 vs EUR 23,024,704 as of 30.06.2024.

factual_claims.claim: Total owners equity stood at EUR 15.58 million at the end of the period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of changes in consolidated equity (page 16) shows total owners' equity of EUR 15,581,325 as of 30.06.2025 (rounded to EUR 15.58 million).

factual_claims.claim: The Group maintained a strong liquidity position, generating a net cash flow of EUR 2.6 million over the twelve-month period and closing the year with a cash and bank balance of EUR 4.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated cash flow statement (page 15) shows 'TOTAL CASH FLOW' of EUR 2,599,005 for 12 months of 2024/25 (~EUR 2.6 million). Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 11) shows 'Cash and bank' of EUR 4,812,202 as of 30.06.2025 (~EUR 4.8 million). Management Report states: 'The Group’s net cash flow for the 12 months of the financial year is EUR 2.6 million. The Group’s cash balance in the balance sheet at the end of the period was EUR 4.8 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Customer prepayments for goods and services reached EUR 3.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report states: 'Advances received from customers for goods totaled EUR 3.9 million.'

factual_claims.claim: To further support liquidity, the parent company maintained an active, unutilized credit line agreement with Luminor Bank AS for EUR 4.95 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 5 (page 19) states: 'To ensure liquidity, the Parent Company has a Credit Line Agreement with Luminor Bank AS for a total amount of EUR 4.95 million, which had not been utilized at the end of the reporting period.'

factual_claims.claim: Total headcount rose slightly to 273 employees at the end of the reporting period, compared with 265 employees at the close of the prior financial year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Guidelines section (page 10) states: 'As of June 30, 2025, the Group had 273 employees (265 employees as of June 30, 2024)'.

factual_claims.claim: Management remains cautious regarding specific forecasts while actively focusing on product diversification and stabilizing turnover to achieve long-term profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Guidelines states: 'The company’s goal is to stabilize turnover to ensure a positive net result in the long term. The Board of SAF Tehnika remains cautious and refrains from providing specific sales and performance forecasts.'

numerical_claims.claim: SAF Tehnika reported an unaudited consolidated net turnover of EUR 26.11 million, representing a 4% decline compared with EUR 27.09 million in the previous financial year.
